name: Wailing Caverns: the Disciple of Naralex offers a slow and a fast escort (#11468)
contract: On Ascension the Disciple of Naralex 3678 offered two options in gossip menu 201: 'Let the event begin!', after
which he walks his path, and a second one after which he runs it at player speed. Both start the same event.

steps.label: SETUP: the hero is in Wailing Caverns
the hero opens the first Disciple's gossip
the first option is the slow escort
the second option is the fast escort
steps.text: I don't have much time left. Let's hurry!

steps.label: CONTROL: after the first option he walks (2.5 yards per second)
the hero opens the second Disciple's gossip
DISCRIMINATING: after the second option he runs (7 x 1.14 = 8 yards per second)
He pauses at his first waypoint
and runs on after the pause
